capabilities.name: bounded platform directory search and access review
capabilities.rationale: ClientPlatform exposes bounded audited platform directory and access-review behavior under platform RBAC rather than donor-specific admin naming.

capabilities.name: platform roles and permission enforcement
capabilities.rationale: Role-gated platform operations are enforced by the canonical ClientPlatform tenant/RBAC boundary.

capabilities.name: controlled duplicate-account consolidation with dry-run, apply and audit evidence

gap.reason: ClientPlatform has atomic cross-channel identity linking and fail-closed conflict handling, but no explicit audited operator merge-plan/apply workflow for already duplicated accounts.

capabilities.name: tenant-scoped broadcasts, publications, scheduling and recipient cohorts
capabilities.rationale: ClientPlatform keeps publication and recipient operations tenant-scoped and exposed through the canonical owner admin surface.

families.title: operator mode / operator queue / handoffs / support

capabilities.name: audited bounded platform support access session
capabilities.rationale: Support access is explicit, bounded, RBAC-controlled and audited instead of relying on implicit global tenant access.

capabilities.name: canonical support-case intake, operator queue and omnichannel handoff
capabilities.rationale: M6-003 provides a canonical support queue and channel-independent handoff behavior.

families.title: reports / analytics / business and platform observability

capabilities.name: business metrics, dispatch observability and platform reporting
capabilities.rationale: ClientPlatform separates tenant business metrics from operator observability while retaining regression evidence for both.

capabilities.name: typed settings, health/readiness and runtime diagnostics
capabilities.rationale: Runtime settings and diagnostics remain fail-closed and operator-scoped.

capabilities.name: RBAC, audit hygiene and explicit access review
capabilities.rationale: Security-sensitive platform operations are fail-closed, permissioned and covered by audit/access contracts.

families.title: release / deploy readiness / rollback / runtime forensics

capabilities.name: release gate, production readiness, rollback and runtime forensic evidence
capabilities.rationale: ClientPlatform has a stricter fail-closed deploy/rollback/evidence contract, including host-only and full-runtime modes.

families.title: subscriptions / tariffs / payments / payment problems / refunds

capabilities.name: tenant subscription/tariff/payment outcomes and payment-problem handling
capabilities.rationale: Payment state is expressed as generic business evidence/outcomes rather than donor product billing identity.

capabilities.name: offerings, storefront, program builder and delivery
capabilities.rationale: Domain-specific products are represented as generic tenant offerings/programs with canonical delivery behavior.

families.title: Growth AI / Growth Autopilot / Next Best Action / autonomous growth

capabilities.name: goal-first growth cockpit, autopilot and economic next-best action
capabilities.rationale: Growth logic remains in canonical ClientPlatform application/domain behavior and preserves the no-second-brain constraint.

capabilities.name: paid-ad connection, spend, attribution, budget and orchestration
capabilities.rationale: ClientPlatform owns generic advertising connections and economic attribution instead of donor-specific campaign state.

families.title: visual generation / assets / vendor / review / media library / jobs

capabilities.name: visual brief, provider gateway, assets, review and render jobs
capabilities.rationale: Visual generation is isolated behind provider/gateway boundaries with tenant-safe review and job contracts.

families.title: speech / voice providers / metrics / experiments / ops

capabilities.name: voice/audio media delivery and runtime validation
capabilities.rationale: Canonical messenger runtime retains voice/media delivery and operational validation across channels.

capabilities.name: speech/voice provider registry, provider metrics, experiments and operator controls

gap.reason: Voice delivery exists, but no evidence-backed platform operator surface for provider registry/experiments and provider-level metrics was found on the pinned ClientPlatform baseline.

families.title: author/content production / assets / export / preview / tasks / workspace

capabilities.name: content/program production, editable assets, preview and publication workspace
capabilities.rationale: Authoring is represented as generic tenant program/content production rather than donor-specific content identity.

families.title: incidents / backup / disaster recovery / recovery evidence

capabilities.name: encrypted backups, restore/disaster recovery and recovery evidence
capabilities.rationale: ClientPlatform has encrypted backup, restore, DR status and production acceptance evidence guarded independently of business runtime.

capabilities.name: partner/referral attribution, retention actions and lifecycle cohorts
capabilities.rationale: Referral and lifecycle behavior is tenant-generic and covered by retention and partner surfaces.

families.title: admin navigation, Back/Home, accessibility and mobile limits across Telegram/VK/MAX

capabilities.name: canonical admin navigation and Back/Home behavior across messenger adapters
capabilities.rationale: Telegram/VK/MAX share canonical application/domain behavior; adapters expose the same navigation and capability truth rather than independent business implementations.
